candidates.explanation: The link in the new-email verification mail is built with the '/confirm-email' frontend path, the same as the sign-up activation mail in userSignUp. The frontend therefore treats the hash as a sign-up confirmation and calls the confirm-email endpoint (AuthService.confirmEmail). That endpoint doesn't apply the pending email change, so the change is never completed. The link should point to '/confirm-new-email', which calls the auth/email/confirm/new endpoint (AuthService.confirmNewEmail).

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, build the URL with frontendDomain + '/confirm-new-email' instead of '/confirm-email'.
